verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a direct Claude Code integration in which Claude Code triggers CodeRabbit reviews and then fixes the issues found, closing the review-to-agent loop. Its IDE/CLI docs and pricing also describe working with AI coding agents ("agent loops", "loops with coding agents") and an extension that runs inside Cursor. Missing for 10: copyable per-finding fix prompts are not evidenced, Codex integration is not mentioned, handoff to Cursor's agent is only implied, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff.
